$comment: Hand-maintained source of truth for the plane.so clone IA. Edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs. Section sequences were read from the clone source (page files, FeaturePage/SolutionsPage data arrays, ComparisonPage/LegacyComparisonPage default exports, plans/company/collections JSX) and spot-checked headless against http://localhost:5247. Convention: a template lists each section id once; where the same block repeats back to back (e.g. three legacy bentos on /teamspaces, the alternating story grid and testimonial on /customers) it is listed once and the section description says so. Where one component is reused for different purposes on the same page (e.g. plans CardGrid), each purpose gets its own id with the same implementedBy.

meta.title: plane.so clone: information architecture
meta.source: Clone route table served by http://localhost:5247 (site/src/App.jsx file-based routes over site/src/pages)
meta.$comment: Counting basis: 97 static page files (all 105 non-underscore .jsx page files minus the 8 [param] files), plus one route per entry that actually exists in the local data files for the 8 dynamic patterns: /blog/:slug 12, /changelog/:slug 11, /careers/:slug 33, /customers/:slug 8, /marketplace/:slug 18, /marketplace/categories/:category 7, /templates/:slug 18, /templates/categories/:category 4. Unknown slugs render a fallback page and are not counted. /launch-week is counted once as a redirect.

liveSitemapSizes.$comment: Context only, from plane.so sitemaps; the clone ships sample data, so these are NOT included in totalRoutes.

meta.chromeNote: chrome = "full" means the route renders inside the global Header + Footer from App.jsx, which is true for every clone route. /launch-week is "redirect". Live plane.so differs on some pages (see IA-README.md); those deviations are not encoded here.

categories.SHELL: Site and section chrome: global header, mega-menus, mobile drawer, footer, plus sticky sub-headers and fixed in-page TOCs.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block: headline, sub-copy, primary actions and hero media.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, testimonials, story cards and headline statistics.
categories.FEATURES: Product capability, workflow, integration, deployment and security explanation modules.
categories.COMPARISON: Comparison tables and competitor or deployment comparisons.
categories.PRICING: Price cards, plan selection and cost calculators.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial, long-form, legal, listings and directories, and article or entry parts.
categories.CONVERSION: Conversion blocks: CTA bands and cards, download, demo, sign-up, contact and application forms.
